description:
Technical SEO audit of one page (a domain's homepage, or `url`; `urls` for several): graded issues with fixes (the Site Audit's page checks: indexability, canonical, redirects, title, meta, headings, structured data, links, images, hreflang), plus robots.txt (sitemaps, AI crawlers blocked), /llms.txt, bot protection and Core Web Vitals (PageSpeed mobile + desktop, real-user CrUX).

Billing: 2¢ per page; free: a page already audited today (incl. the PSI re-poll), one that didn't load, a non-HTML file, a redirect to another site. 30/hour per host.

When to call: one page's technical health or Core Web Vitals. Whole site: crawl_site (the Site Audit, 1¢ per 10 pages). Not the citation audit (get_audit).

Timing: ~10 s. A PSI strategy still "pending": call again after pagespeed_retry_after_seconds (free; waits up to 38 s). Cached 10 min.

Returns: { url, final_url, redirected, redirect_chain?, response_status, fetch_error, summary: { errors, warnings, notices, indexable, fix_first }, issues: [{ id, severity: error|warning|notice, title, found?, why?, fix, fix_tools? }] (errors first; crawl_site's ids; fix_tools run on wordpress_site_id), notices_omitted?, meta, schema_types, headings, robots: { found, status, sitemaps, ai_crawlers: { allowed, blocked, fix } | null }, llms_txt, core_web_vitals?: { verdict: pass|fail|unknown, based_on, past_good? } (quote this one), pagespeed: { mobile, desktop } | null, cwv_summary?, pagespeed_note?, field_data?, bot_protection?, billing, latest_crawl?, suggested_next, next_step }. Each strategy: { status: ok|error|pending, score (0–100), lcpSec, inpMs, clsUnitless, fcpSec, ttfbSec, tbtMs, field, grades, causes: [{ id, title, detail?, saves?, wasted_kb?, examples? }] (what slows the page, biggest saving first), lcpElement }; grades rate each metric good|needs_improvement|poor, core_web_vitals pass|fail|null (field data only). Lab = one Lighthouse run; field = real-user p75. bot_protection { verdict: checker_refused|ai_blocked|verifies_bots, note, fix? }: relay its note.

domain.description: Hostname, e.g. "linear.app": its homepage is fetched unless `url` or `urls` is set. A value with a path ("linear.app/pricing") means that page.

include_pagespeed.description: Default true. false skips PageSpeed Insights / Core Web Vitals for a fast meta + schema + robots check.

refresh_pagespeed.description: Default false. true skips cached Core Web Vitals and measures again, e.g. to verify a performance fix.

url.description: Optional exact page URL to fetch instead of the homepage, e.g. https://example.com/pricing. Fetched as given; must be an HTML page.

urls.description: Several exact page URLs in one call (max 10), each audited and billed as its own page; the answer is { pages: [...], billing }. Instead of domain / url.

name: run_technical_audit
title: Run a technical SEO check on one page
